render_note: Fig. 5.68 is a 1021 x 895 pixel indexed image placed at 100 dpi; the 100 dpi render is one render pixel per image pixel. The figure has no north arrow; the north line is a north-south line of the 5 m trench grid printed on the same base map.

north.evidence: Fig. 5.68 'General plan of the structural remains in Central Area (1:500)' (PDF p. 111, printed p. 97) has no north arrow. Its base map, with the same contours and 5 m trench grid, is Fig. 3.2 'Trench numbers of the Central Area' (PDF p. 36). The report states on PDF p. 34 (printed p. 20): 'All the trenches in the main habitation area were oriented in cardinal directions (Figures 3.1 and 3.2).' Fig. 3.1 (PDF p. 35) shows the same 5 m grid with a four-point compass star marked 'N' drawn parallel to the grid. North is therefore taken as the page-upward direction of the grid's north-south lines; whether the cardinal directions are true or magnetic is not stated. The north line picked is the grid line at x 531, from south (bottom) to north (top).
north.survey_year_evidence: Trench grid laid out in the 2006-07 season and extended in 2007-08 (report pp. 20-21); the year 2007 is recorded.

scale.evidence: Scale bar at lower right labelled '0 10m'; end ticks at x 453.5 and 530 (middle tick at 491.5); the caption gives 1:500.
